info.name: FinPilot AI - Complete API Collection
info.description:
Complete API test collection for FinPilot AI backend.

## Setup Order
1. Import both this file and FinPilot_Environment.json into Postman.
2. Select the 'FinPilot AI - Local Dev' environment.
3. Run '01 - Get CSRF Token' first (Auth folder).
4. Run '02 - Login' next.
5. Run '03 - Get Current User (me)' — this auto-sets organization_id.
6. All other requests are now ready to run.

## Auth Model
- Cookie-based Django session authentication (NO JWT, NO Bearer tokens).
- Postman must have 'Automatically follow redirects' ON and cookie management ON.
- Every mutation (POST/PUT/PATCH) needs header: X-CSRFToken: {{csrf_token}}
- Every org-scoped endpoint needs header: X-Organization-ID: {{organization_id}}

## Amount Encoding
- All monetary amounts are integers in PAISE (Indian minor units).
- ₹1 = 100 paise. Example: ₹1,000 = 100000 (integer, no decimal).

## GST Rate Encoding
- GST rates are in BASIS POINTS (bps). 100 bps = 1%.
- 18% GST = 1800 bps. 5% GST = 500 bps. 28% GST = 2800 bps.

item.name: 05 - GST Rates
item.description: GST rate management. Create these before creating invoices with GST. Rate is in BASIS POINTS: 18% = 1800.

exec: console.log('First GST rate ID saved: ' + body.results[0].id);

request.description:
Create a GST rate. rate_bps is basis points: 100 bps = 1%. Common values:

  1200 = 12%
  1800 = 18%
  2800 = 28%
X-Organization-ID: REQUIRED
X-CSRFToken: REQUIRED

item.name: 13 - Reconciliation
item.description: Bank statement upload and reconciliation matching. Backend fully implemented; UI is coming-soon in frontend.

formdata.description: Select a CSV or XLSX bank statement file from your computer

request.description:
Upload a CSV or XLSX bank statement. Max 10 MB.
Returns batch_id, detected_columns, sample_rows.
Content-Type is set automatically by Postman for multipart/form-data.
X-Organization-ID: REQUIRED
X-CSRFToken: REQUIRED

Map detected CSV columns to canonical field names.
Required keys in mapping: transaction_date, description, credit_amount, debit_amount, account_identifier
Values should be the actual column headers from your CSV file (shown in Step 1 response as detected_columns).
X-Organization-ID: REQUIRED
X-CSRFToken: REQUIRED

List pending (suggested) reconciliation matches. Returns up to 100, sorted by confidence score.
X-Organization-ID: REQUIRED

Confirm a suggested match. This CREATES a Payment + PaymentAllocation record automatically.
X-Organization-ID: REQUIRED
X-CSRFToken: REQUIRED

item.name: 14 - Invoice Imports
item.description: Bulk invoice import via CSV or XLSX. Three-step process: upload → review → commit.

request.description:
Download the CSV import template. Use 'Send and Download' in Postman.
Columns: invoice_number, invoice_date, due_date, customer_name, subtotal, discount, tax, total, currency, notes
Download the XLSX import template. Use 'Send and Download' in Postman.

formdata.description: Select a CSV or XLSX invoice file (max 10 MB)

request.description:
Step 1: Upload. Returns batch_id + preview of validated rows.
Row status values: valid, error, duplicate
X-Organization-ID: REQUIRED
X-CSRFToken: REQUIRED

Step 2: Review. Poll batch status and row-level validation results.
X-Organization-ID: REQUIRED

Step 3: Commit. Supply the UUID list of valid row IDs to create as invoices.
row_ids: array of row UUIDs (get these from the batch detail response).
Only rows with status=valid are committed; others are skipped.
X-Organization-ID: REQUIRED
X-CSRFToken: REQUIRED

item.name: 15 - Exports
item.description: CSV file download endpoints. These return binary CSV streams, not JSON. Use 'Send and Download' in Postman.

request.description:
Download all invoices as CSV.
Columns: invoice_number, customer_name, invoice_date, due_date, status, subtotal, discount, tax, total, cgst, sgst, igst, paid, outstanding, currency
Use 'Send and Download' in Postman to save the CSV file.
X-Organization-ID: REQUIRED (also as query param)

Download all customers as CSV.
Columns: name, contact_name, email, phone, gstin, payment_terms_days, active, created_at
X-Organization-ID: REQUIRED (also as query param)

Download all payments as CSV.
Columns: payment_date, customer_name, amount, currency, method, reference, allocated_to_invoices, created_at
X-Organization-ID: REQUIRED (also as query param)
